name: 3D Avatars
description: Shows your characters and personas as animated 3D models that blink, talk, and change faces with each reply. Uses VRM model files; Marinara Engine versions after 2.5.1 also take MMD PMX, GLB and FBX models. Set up each avatar on the agent's page in Agents, then add the Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Misc Agents for Roleplay and Game modes.
